paragraphs: Hyman cites Vayikra Rabbah 4:6 and Midrash Tehillim 9:9: a philosopher asked Rabbi Ela’sha, “Did not the prophet say thus—?” He answered him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: In the consulted Vayikra Rabbah 4:6, Rabbi Ela’sha narrates a gentile’s question to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Karcha; in Midrash Tehillim 9:9, Philippus asks Rabbi Ela’sha. Hyman’s compressed account is retained alongside these source-specific differences.
